See how risks are classified by the Causal Factors Taxonomy. The Causal Taxonomy of AI Risks, adapted from Yampolskiy (2016), classifies risks by its causal factors (1) entity (human, AI), (2) intentionality (intentional, unintentional), and (3) timing (pre-deployment, post-deployment).

This sheet shows the total number and percentage of papers and risks which relate to each of our causal factors (e.g., entity, intention and timing), and how these overlap; for instance, the percentage of all risks coded as 'human, intentional and post-deployment'.
